name: new_bank_v2_song_28_state_exploratory
source: user-supplied Song HDF5 v3, 8 EMG channels at 250 Hz and real IMU at 112 Hz, four sessions on 2026-09-18
preprocessing: continuous causal 40 Hz highpass plus 50/100 Hz notch; EMG 50 samples, aligned prior IMU 22 samples; no target-fitted state
endpoint: 28 native hand-by-arm labels, one probability vector per formal trial
classifier: source-window StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=0, as in saved causal 28-state baseline
selection_rule: Among four v2 arms, highest S03 trial-level joint macro-F1; tie by lower trial log loss then listed order. Never select on S04.
reference_check: Legacy F0+real IMU S03/S04 joint accuracy and macro-F1 must exactly reproduce saved causal Song baseline
scope: One person, one date, cue-labelled stable windows; S01-S03 collection readiness failed, S04 passed; S04 was previously inspected and is exploratory, not independent deployment validation
